services.title: Lactation support session
services.homeBlurb: Latch, pain, supply, pumping, mastitis, weight gain, and more.
services.subtitle: 1 to 1 consultation · 60 to 90 minutes

paragraphs.text: Develop strategies for overcoming breast and chestfeeding issues, with an expert in your corner.
Includes support with galactagogues, inducing lactation in non-gestational parents, and healing nipple damage or recurrent mastitis.

list.heading: Breast pump guidance
items: Pump types and how they differ
Breast sizing for the right flange fit
Planning when and where to pump, and returning to work

services.title: Bottle feeding support
services.homeBlurb: Paced feeding, formula questions, mixed feeding, gas, and colic.
services.subtitle: 1 to 1 session · 60 to 90 minutes

paragraphs.text: A session with an infant feeding expert to work through bottle feeding challenges, without judgment, whatever your feeding goals are.

services.title: Prenatal breastfeeding master class
services.homeBlurb: A two part, in-home education series before baby arrives.
services.subtitle: 2 part in-home education · 2 × 60 minutes

paragraphs.text: Learn what you need to know about lactation and infant feeding before your baby arrives. Each course is customized to your own goals, fears, and previous experiences.
Sessions include a personalized risk assessment and medical history review, so we can plan around anything that might affect your feeding journey.

services.title: Tongue tie assessment + support
services.homeBlurb: A full oral assessment with an experienced practitioner.
services.subtitle: 1 to 1 assessment · 60 to 90 minutes

paragraphs.text: An assessment with an expert Tongue Tie Practitioner. A shortened or restrictive piece of tissue under the tongue can limit mobility and affect feeding, at the breast or the bottle.
You’ll leave with context, education, referral guidance where needed, and non-surgical alternatives. Documentation for insurance requirements prior to specialist referral is available.

right.heading: Your appointment includes
items: Full oral assessment with an evidence-based scoring tool
A bespoke plan for your baby
